instruction_in_the_tail.notes: This release continues the regular maintenance series for the integration. The dependency on the vendor library moves forward one patch level, which picks up a fix for a connection that was left open when the hub stopped responding mid-poll. Translations were refreshed from the community platform and now cover twenty-one languages. The diagnostics download now redacts the account identifier alongside the token, matching what the config entry already did. A long-standing warning about a deprecated helper import is gone, so the log stays quiet on start up. Nothing in the configuration format changed, no entity identifiers were renamed, and no manual step is needed after installing. Users who pinned an older version for the reconnection problem can move forward safely. The test suite grew by a handful of cases around the reconnect path, and the continuous integration run now exercises the oldest supported core release as well as the newest.
